scientific_limitations_and_integrity.priority_risks: Unindexed special-case results and unavailable complete text of the foundational 2007 strong-metric-dimension paper may conceal earlier coverage.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Any finite projective plane of order \(q\geq2\), including non-Desarguesian planes; strong metric resolution only.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.unproved_or_unclaimed: No classification of all finite projective planes, no ordinary metric-dimension theorem, no independent external validation or global priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: The complete proof uses projective-plane axioms; direct finite checks cover the Desarguesian planes of orders 2 and 3 only.

title: Strong-resolving polynomials of finite projective-plane incidence graphs
